summary: Hut 8 Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiary, Beacon Point DC LLC, priced a $4.250 billion offering of 6.129% Senior Secured Notes due 2042. The notes are sold to QIBs under Rule 144A and offshore to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S; closing is expected June 9, 2026, subject to market conditions. This is an ordinary debt capital markets transaction—the company is raising funds through a secured note issuance, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, go-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. The filing is a routine disclosure of a financing event, not a transformative event. Watch for market conditions affecting the close.
